items.title: Peer avatar appears on the final bubble of an incoming run
items.precondition: Execution complete; signed in to a conversation with at least three consecutive peer messages, or able to receive them.
steps: Open /messages/:conversationId containing a consecutive run of incoming messages.
Confirm that only the final bubble in the run has the peer avatar beside it.
Create or locate a boundary (an outgoing message, a later incoming message after the grouping time gap, or a timeline event), then inspect the next incoming run.
items.expected: Each incoming run has exactly one peer avatar on its latest bubble. Single incoming messages keep their avatar, and outgoing bubbles never gain one.
items.evidence: User-confirmed 2026-08-20: the completed change was tested and the avatar placement is correct.
items.notes: User acceptance recorded; verify desktop and narrow/mobile widths when the next visual-regression pass runs.

items.title: Feature branch is current and merge-clean with dev
items.precondition: T1 is complete and origin/dev has been fetched.
steps: Merge origin/dev into kylie/message-avatar-fix and resolve the shared changelog conflict by retaining dev's release ledger.
Confirm a merge-tree analysis between origin/dev and the updated feature branch succeeds without conflicts.
Confirm AGENTS.md defers feature-branch CHANGELOG.md edits to integration or release promotion.
items.expected: The branch contains current dev, has no merge conflict, and the documented workflow removes the shared changelog from future feature-branch changes.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: merged origin/dev in f4f0db8; git merge-tree --write-tree origin/dev HEAD succeeded. AGENTS.md now reserves CHANGELOG.md for dev integration or release promotion.
items.notes: This prevents this changelog conflict class; ordinary code conflicts still require a current-base sync before merge.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: Each command succeeds with no errors caused by this presentation-only change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: frontend typecheck, lint, and production build passed. The notification suite also passed 4/4.
items.notes: Lint reported six pre-existing warnings outside the changed file; Vite retained its pre-existing large-chunk advisory.
